channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 01
item.description:
61 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Work‑in‑progress changes to rabbit AI: added a first pass at rabbit interest behavior (e.g., how rabbits react to nearby players or stimuli).
  • Fixed a bug in the Russian Roulette DLC where the storage container incorrectly rejected valid items (CanAcceptItem logic).

Vehicles

  • Fixed missing colliders on the attack helicopter frame that were causing unintended damage to players and structures.

Radiation & Environmental Hazards

  • Increased radiation output of sprinkler systems when using radwater: doubled the base output and added an additional 1.5× multiplier, making them significantly more lethal.

NPC & AI

  • Work‑in‑progress changes to rabbit AI: added a first pass at rabbit interest behavior (e.g., how rabbits react to nearby players or stimuli).
  • Adjusted NPC spawner position in Underwater Labs to avoid monument blocker, fixing NPC spawn issues.

DLC Content

  • Fixed a bug in the Russian Roulette DLC where the storage container incorrectly rejected valid items (CanAcceptItem logic).

Base & Facility Access

  • Added monument blockers to the red key‑card doors of the Underwater Labs, preventing players from bypassing the intended access restrictions.

Wildlife & Critters

  • Added a first-pass squirrel interest mechanic, giving squirrels a basic reaction to player presence.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed a race condition when saving Display Box storage, preventing possible item loss or duplication.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Settings menu dropdowns now display dynamic text correctly and use consistent colors.

Combat Visuals

  • Crossbow and other bows now show the arrowhead during the reload animation, aligning the visual with the actual shot timing.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 31
item.description:
47 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Large rig monument blocker collision fixed and missing vent cages added to monuments.
  • Beach area added to water pipe topology, expanding pipe placement options near coastlines.

Base Building

  • Pipe access improved: trees no longer spawn inside pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.

Gameplay Bugs

  • Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.

Animals & Farming

  • New shearing interaction lets players shear livestock for resources.

Deployables

  • Carvable pumpkin deployment improved for more reliable placement.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Footstep sounds now play correctly when heavily armored or wearing diving fins, restoring audio feedback while moving.

UI & Quality of Life

  • High-Quality Metal collectable now displays its proper name token, fixing missing label issues.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 30
item.description:
12 development commits

Audio & Communication

  • Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

Gameplay & Balance

  • Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.
